u0: At the start, the agent has not yet reached the exit and has not carried the box on any step, so the optional preference has no progress. The mandatory objective remains to reach the exit. Until the agent either reaches the exit or carries the box on a step, ordinary movement and waiting leave the task progress unchanged.
u1: The agent has carried the box on one distinct step away from the exit, giving partial progress toward the optional preference. It still needs to reach the exit, and to fulfill the preference it should carry the box on at least one more separate step; arriving at the exit while still carrying it would also count. Reaching the exit without carrying the box ends the task but leaves the preference incomplete. The agent may put the box down and wait without losing this recorded progress, but must carry it again to make further preference progress.
u2: The agent has reached the exit, so the mandatory objective is satisfied and the episode finishes successfully. No further action is needed. The optional preference may or may not have been fulfilled, since arrival is possible after zero, one, or at least two separate steps of carrying the box.
u3: The agent has carried the box on at least two separate steps away from the exit, so the optional preference is already satisfied. The remaining mandatory objective is simply to reach the exit. Further carrying, dropping, or waiting does not change task progress, and the task completes on reaching the exit even if the box is no longer being carried.
